profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Front End JavaScript Developer and a UX/UI designer I am not only able to build out front end projects I am also skillful in designing and creating mockups, high fidelity prototypes using tools like Figma, Adobe XD and Adobe Illustrator. I build out the front end focusing on visual details, usability, and user's interests.

I enjoy learning about how things work, understanding the ins and outs of it. Problem solver, self-motivated, willing to learn new things, able to take charge and lead, and happily work independently or together with teammates. 

==============================================================================
LANGUAGES AND TECHNOLOGIES
==============================================================================
  •  Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, REST, JSON, ReactJS
  •  Tools: Visual Studio Code, Adobe XD, Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Lightroom
  •  Database: MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase
  •  Skills: Design Icons, Design UI, Creating mockups, Agile methodology, Scrum

positions.title: UX/UI Designer, Frontend Developer
positions.description: Designing and building internal applications for T-Mobile's Quantum team. Internal applications are created to improve user experience for the use of T-Mobile's data engineers, solution architects, etc. that are analyzing big data. Using Adobe XD, Illustrator, Invision Studio to design mockup, high fidelity prototypes, icons, and logos, and React and its various libraries to modify, enhance, and build the applications UI.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Assisting the dentist during a variety of treatment procedures
Taking dental radiographs (x-rays)
Asking about the patient's medical history and taking blood pressure and pulse
Serving as an infection control officer, developing infection control protocol and preparing and sterilizing instruments and equipment
Helping patients feel comfortable before, during and after dental treatment
Performing office management tasks that often require the use of a personal computer
communicating with patients and suppliers (e.g., scheduling appointments, answering the telephone, billing and ordering supplies)

volunteerExperiences.companyName: OUR LADY OF LOURDES CATHOLIC CHURCH WASHINGTON
volunteerExperiences.description: Leads a vocal ensemble. Ensure that the members attend rehearsals and are at their best when performing. Performs a balancing act of sorts when interacting with the vocal ensemble. For one, setting example by being firm yet positive and punctual. Additionally, remembering to warm up before rehearsal or a performance. Scheduling regular rehearsals and address problems between group members as soon as they arise.

company.name: OUR LADY OF LOURDES CATHOLIC CHURCH WASHINGTON

projects.title: Clickity Game
projects.description: I created a simple, fun, memory game using React, Javascript, HTML, CSS and Heroku, which challenges a user to try to click on each picture only once before they click any one twice to win the game, else they will lose and have to start over!

projects.title: Burgerlor
projects.description: A fun hamburger web app which allows users to interact and manipulate a MySQL database by utilizing the CRUD(create, read, update, and delete)operation. I used Express Handlebars, Express, JavaScript, CSS, and Node.js to build this web application and MySQL as a database to store the hamburger's information.
